## Welcome

I am an incoming PhD student in Economics at ENS de Lyon.

My research interests include urban and transport economics, economic
geography, political economy, and spatial inequality.

This website contains information about my research, academic background,
and selected research notes.

## Research interests

- Urban and transport economics
- Economic geography
- Spatial inequality
- Political economy
- Applied econometrics
